G1000.strongs: a throw (as a measure of distance)
senses: (βάλλω), a throw; λίθου β. (Thuc., v, 65, 2), a stone's throw: [[r:LUK.22.41|Luk 22:41.]]† (AS)
(βολίς, in sense of sounding-lead), to heave the lead, take soundings: [[r:ACT.27.28|Act 27:28.]]† (AS)
Βοός and Βοές (RV, Βοάζ, Rec. Βοόζ), ὁ, indecl. (Heb. בֹּעַז), Boaz ([[r:RUT.2.1|Rut 2:1]]): [[r:MAT.1.5|Mat 1:5]], [[r:LUK.3.32|Luk 3:32]].† (AS)

G1005.forms: βορρᾶς, -ᾶ (Attic contr. of Βορέας, the North wind personified)

G1006.root: a prolonged form of a primary verb (compare [[w:G0977]], [[w:G1016]])
G1006.strongs: to pasture; by extension to, fodder; reflexively, to graze
senses: prop., of a herdsman, to feed: [[r:MAT.8.33|Mat 8:33]], [[r:MRK.5.14|Mrk 5:14]], [[r:LUK.8.34|Luk 8:34 15:15]]; metaphorically, of Christian pastoral care, [[r:JHN.21.15|Jhn 21:15, 17]]. Pass., of cattle, to feed, graze: [[r:MAT.8.30|Mat 8:30]], [[r:MRK.5.11|Mrk 5:11]], [[r:LUK.8.32|Luk 8:32]].† SYN.: ποιμαίνειν, to tend, shepherd, a wider term, including oversight as well as feeding (see Tr., Syn., §xxv). (AS)
Βοσόρ see Βεώρ - ὁ, indecl. (Heb. בְּעוֹר), Beor, father of Balaam: [[r:2PE.2.15|2Pe 2:15]] (Rec. Βοσόρ).† (AS)
green herb: [[r:HEB.6.7|Heb 6:7.]]† SYN.: λάχανον, a garden herb, a vegetable. (AS)

G1010.strongs: an adviser, i.e. (specially) a councillor or member of the Jewish Sanhedrin
senses: (βουλεύω), a councillor, a senator; of a member of the Sanhedrin: [[r:MRK.15.34|Mrk 15:34]], [[r:LUK.23.50|Luk 23:50]].† (AS)

G1011.strongs: to advise, i.e. (reflexively) deliberate, or (by implication) resolve
G1011.kjv: consult, take counsel, determine, be minded, purpose
senses: (βουλή), to take counsel, deliberate, resolve. In mid.,
to take counsel with oneself, consider: before εἰ, [[r:LUK.14.31|Luk 14:31.]]
to determine with oneself, resolve: with inf., [[r:ACT.5.33|Act 5:33 27:39]]; with accusative, [[r:2CO.1.17|2Co 1:17]]; before ἵνα, [[r:JHN.11.53|Jhn 11:53 12:10]] (cf. παρα-, συμ-). † (AS)

G1012.strongs: volition, i.e. (objectively) advice, or (by implication) purpose
senses: (βούλομαι), counsel, purpose (in cl., esp. of the gods): [[r:LUK.23.51|Luk 23:51]], [[r:ACT.4.28|Act 4:28 5:38 19:1 27:12, 42]]; pl., [[r:1CO.4.5|1Co 4:5]]; of the Divine purpose, [[r:HEB.6.17|Heb 6:17]]; τ. βουλὴν τ. θελήματος αὐτοῦ, [[r:EPH.1.11|Eph 1:11]]; β. τ. Θεοῦ, [[r:LUK.7.30|Luk 7:30]], [[r:ACT.2.23|Act 2:23 13:36 20:27]].† (AS)

G1014.root: middle voice of a primary verb
G1014.kjv: be disposed, minded, intend, list, (be, of own) will (-ing)
senses: to will, wish, desire, purpose, be minded, implying more strongly than θέλω (which see), the deliberate exercise of volition (see Hort on [[r:JAS.1.18|Jas 1:18]]): with inf. (M, Pr., 205; Bl., §69, 4), [[r:MRK.15.15|Mrk 15:15]], [[r:ACT.5.28|Act 5:28, 33 12:4 15:37 17:20 18:15, 27 19:30 22:30 23:28 27:43 28:18]], [[r:2CO.1.15|2Co 1:15]], [[r:1TI.6.9|1Ti 6:9]], [[r:HEB.6.17|Heb 6:17]], II Jhn.12, 3Jo 10, Ju 5; with accusative, [[r:2CO.1.17|2Co 1:17]]; with accusative and inf., [[r:PHP.1.12|Php 1:12]], [[r:1TI.2.8|1Ti 2:8 5:14]], [[r:TIT.3.8|Tit 3:8]], [[r:2PE.3.9|2Pe 3:9]]; of the will making choice between alternatives, [[r:MAT.1.19|Mat 1:19 11:27]], [[r:LUK.10.22|Luk 10:22]], [[r:ACT.25.20|Act 25:20]], [[r:1CO.12.11|1Co 12:11]], [[r:JAS.3.4|Jas 3:4 4:4]]; εἰ βούλει (cl., a courteous phrase = θέλεις, colloq.; Bl., §21, 8; LS, see word), [[r:LUK.22.42|Luk 22:42]]; with subjc., adding force to a question of deliberation (Bl., §64, 6), [[r:JHN.18.39|Jhn 18:39]]; βουληθείς, of set purpose (see Hort, in l.), [[r:JAS.1.18|Jas 1:18]]; impf., ἐβουλόμην (= cl. βουλοίμην ἄν; Bl., §63, 5; Lft., Phm. 13), [[r:ACT.25.22|Act 25:22]], Phm 13 (see also Cremer, 143).† (AS)

G1015.forms: βουνός, -οῦ, ὁ (a Cyrenaїc word, Hdt., iv, 199)

G1016.strongs: an ox (as grazing), i.e. an animal of that species ("beef")

G1017.root: from βραβεύς (an umpire of uncertain derivation)
G1017.strongs: an award (of arbitration), i.e. (specially) a prize in the public games
senses: (βραβεύς, an umpire), a prize in the games: [[r:1CO.9.24|1Co 9:24]]; metaphorically, of the Christian's reward, [[r:PHP.3.14|Php 3:14.]]† (AS)

G1018.strongs: to arbitrate, i.e. (genitive case) to govern (figuratively, prevail)
senses: generally, to arbitrate, decide (Isocr., Dem.; Lft., Col., l.with; MM, see word): [[r:COL.3.15|Col 3:15]]; (with) in some late writers, to direct, rule, control (so in Col., l.with, accusative to Thayer, see word, Meyer, in l.), (cf. κατα-βραβεύω). † (AS)
More frequently intrans., to be slow, to tarry: [[r:1TI.3.15|1Ti 3:15]], [[r:2PE.3.9|2Pe 3:9]]. † (AS)

G1020.root: from [[w:G1021]] and a prolonged form of [[w:G4126]]

senses: slow: εἰς τὸ λαλῆσαι, [[r:JAS.1.19|Jas 1:19]]; metaphorically, of the understanding: β. τ. καρδίᾳ, assoc. with ἀνόητος, [[r:LUK.24.25|Luk 24:25.]]† (AS)
1. slowness , (Iliad by Homer), attic 2. of the mind, (Plato Philosophus) (ML)

G1023.root: properly, comparative of [[w:G1024]], but apparently in the sense of βράσσω (to wield)
senses: the arm; as in OT, β. Κυρίου, metaphorically, for the Divine power: [[r:LUK.1.51|Luk 1:51]], [[r:JHN.12.38|Jhn 12:38]]" (LXX), [[r:ACT.13.17|Act 13:17.]]† (AS)

G1024.strongs: short (of time, place, quantity, or number)
senses: of time; short, little: βραχύ, [[r:ACT.5.34|Act 5:34]]; μετὰ β., [[r:LUK.22.58|Luk 22:58]]; β. τι, a short time, [[r:HEB.2.7|Heb 2:7]], 9 RV, mg.;

of distance: [[r:ACT.27.28|Act 27:28]]; (with) of quantity or value, little, few: [[r:JHN.6.7|Jhn 6:7]], [[r:HEB.2.7|Heb 2:7]], 9 RV, txt.; pl., διὰ βραχέων, in few words, [[r:HEB.13.22|Heb 13:22.]] † (AS)

G1025.strongs: an infant (properly, unborn) literally or figuratively
senses: a newborn child, a babe: [[r:LUK.2.12|Luk 2:12, 16 18:15]], [[r:ACT.7.19|Act 7:19]], [[r:1PE.2.2|1Pe 2:2]]; ἀπὸ βρέφους, from infancy, [[r:2TI.3.15|2Ti 3:15.]] † (AS)

In late Gk. writers and vernac. = ὕειν, to send rain, to rain (Kennedy, Sources, 39, 155): [[r:MAT.5.45|Mat 5:45]]; trop., β. πῦρ κ. θεῖον, [[r:LUK.17.29|Luk 17:29]]; impers., βρέχει, it rains: [[r:JAS.5.17|Jas 5:17]]; with ὐετός as subj., [[r:REV.11.6|Rev 11:6.]] † (AS)
= βροχετός, a wetting (in π., of irrigation in Egypt; Deiss., LAE, 77).
a noose, a slip-knot, a halter: metaphorically, a restraint (not, as AV, R, txt., a snare): [[r:1CO.7.35|1Co 7:35.]]† (AS)

G1031.strongs: to grate the teeth (in pain or rage)

G1032.forms: βρύω, poët., late prose and vernac.
G1032.strongs: to swell out, i.e. (by implication) to gush

G1033.strongs: food (literally or figuratively), especially (ceremonially) articles allowed or forbidden by the Jewish law

G1035.strongs: (abstractly) eating (literally or figuratively); by extension (concretely) food (literally or figuratively)
senses: eating: β. καὶ πόσις, [[r:ROM.14.17|Rom 14:17]], [[r:COL.2.16|Col 2:16]] (see Lft., ICC, in l.); with genitive obj., [[r:1CO.8.4|1Co 8:4]]; metaphorically, corrosion, rust: [[r:MAT.6.19|Mat 6:19, 20]].

As also in cl. (Hom., al.) = βρῶμα, food: [[r:JHN.6.27|Jhn 6:27]]a, [[r:2CO.9.10|2Co 9:10]], [[r:COL.2.16|Col 2:16]] (EV, but see supr.). [[r:HEB.12.16|Heb 12:16]]; metaphorically, of spiritual nourishment, [[r:JHN.4.32|Jhn 4:32 6:27b, 55]].† (AS)

G1036.strongs: to sink; by implication, to drown
senses: (βυθός), trans., to cause to sink, to sink: metaphorically, εἰς ὄλεθρον, [[r:1TI.6.9|1Ti 6:9]]; pass., to sink, intrans.: [[r:LUK.5.7|Luk 5:7.]]† (AS)
the depth of the sea, the deep sea: [[r:2CO.11.25|2Co 11:25.]] † (AS)

G1038.forms: βυρσεύς, -έως, ὁ (βύρσα, a hide), late form for βυρσοδέψης

G1039.strongs: made of linen (neuter a linen cloth)

senses: byssus, a fine species of flax, also the linen made from it: [[r:LUK.16.19|Luk 16:19.]]† (AS)

G1041.strongs: properly, a stand, i.e. (specially) an altar

G1042.strongs: the knoll; gabbatha, a vernacular term for the Roman tribunal in Jerusalem
senses: Γαββαθα (Rec. -θᾶ), ἡ, indecl., Gabbatha, the Greek transliteration of an uncertain Aramaic word (DB, see word; Dalman, Words, 7), used as the equivalent of λιθόστρωτον, stone pavement: [[r:JHN.19.13|Jhn 19:13.]]† (AS)

G1043.forms: Γαβριήλ, ὁ, indecl. (Heb. גַּבְרִיאֵל, hero of God)

senses: a gangrene, an eating sore, which leads to mortification: [[r:2TI.2.17|2Ti 2:17.]]† (AS)

G1046.root: from Γαδαρά (a town east of the Jordan)
G1046.strongs: a Gadarene or inhabitant of Gadara
senses: (Γαδαρά, Gadara, the capital of Peræa), Gadarene, of Gadara: [[r:MAT.8.28|Mat 8:28]] (Rec. Γεργεσηνῶν), [[r:MRK.5.1|Mrk 5:1]], Rec. (Edd., Γερασηνῶν), [[r:LUK.8.26|Luk 8:26, 37]] Rec. (Edd., Γερασηνῶν).† (AS)

G1048.strongs: Gazah (i.e. Azzah), a place in Palestine
senses: Γάζα -ης, ἡ (Heb. עַזָּה), Gaza, in OT, one of the five chief cities of the Philistines: [[r:ACT.8.26|Act 8:26.]]† (AS)

G1049.strongs: a treasure-house, i.e. a court in the temple for the collection-boxes
senses: γαζο-φυλάκιον, -ου, τό (γάζα, φυλακή), treasury: also, apparently, the trumpet-shaped chests into which the peoples' temple-offerings were thrown (DB, iv, 96; DCG, ii, 748): [[r:MRK.12.41|Mrk 12:41, 43]] [[r:LUK.21.1|Luk 21:1]], [[r:JHN.8.20|Jhn 8:20]].† (AS)
Γαῖος, -ου, ὁ (Γάϊος, Rec.), Gaius, the name of a Christian;
The one to whom in Ep. Jo is addressed: III Jo 1. † (AS)

milk: [[r:1CO.9.7|1Co 9:7.]] Metaphorical, of elementary Christian teaching: [[r:1CO.3.2|1Co 3:2]], [[r:HEB.5.12|Heb 5:12, 13]]; τὸ λογικὸν ἄδολον γ., the rational (spiritual) genuine milk (see Hort, in l.), [[r:1PE.2.2|1Pe 2:2]] (in support of AV, milk of the word, see ICC, in l.).† (AS)

G1052.forms: Γαλάτης, -ου, ὁ (originally syn. with cl. Κέλτης; cf. [[r:1MA.8.2|1Ma 8:2]], and see next word)
G1052.strongs: a Galatian or inhabitant of Galatia

senses: a gentilic region in Asia Minor, settled by Gauls (iii/B.C).
A Roman Province which included this region (DB, ii, 85ff.): [[r:1CO.16.1|1Co 16:1]], [[r:GAL.1.2|Gal 1:2]], [[r:2TI.4.10|2Ti 4:10]] (T, Tr., mg., Γαλλίαν), [[r:1PE.1.1|1Pe 1:1.]] † (AS)

G1056.forms: Γαλιλαία, -ας, ἡ (Heb. הַגָּלִיל, the circle, district)
G1056.strongs: Galilæa (i.e. the heathen circle), a region of Palestine
senses: Galilee, the name of the northern region of Palestine in NT times: Γ. τῶν ἐθνῶν, [[r:MAT.4.15|Mat 4:15]] (LXX); θάλασσα τῆς Γ., [[r:MAT.15.29|Mat 15:29]] (cf. [[r:JHN.6.1|Jhn 6:1]]). (AS)
Gamaliel the elder, a Pharisee and Doctor of the Law: [[r:ACT.5.34|Act 5:34 22:3]].† (AS)
mid. (and in late writers, pass.), to give oneself in marriage, marry (nubere): [[r:1CO.7.39|1Co 7:39]];
in Hellenistic (M, Pr., 159), act. (as of the man), to marry: absol., [[r:1CO.7.28|1Co 7:28, 34]] [[r:1TI.5.11|1Ti 5:11, 14]]. with accusative, [[r:MRK.10.12|Mrk 10:12.]]

G1061.strongs: to espouse (a daughter to a husband)
senses: γαμίζω (γάμος), to give in marriage, a daughter: [[r:1CO.7.38|1Co 7:38.]] Pass., [[r:MAT.22.30|Mat 22:30 24:38]], [[r:MRK.12.25|Mrk 12:25]], [[r:LUK.17.27|Luk 17:27 20:35]] (WH, mg., γαμίσκονται; cf. γαμίζω).† (AS)

G1063.strongs: properly, assigning a reason (used in argument, explanation or intensification; often with other particles)
G1063.kjv: and, as, because (that), but, even, for, indeed, no doubt, seeing, then, therefore, verily, what, why, yet
senses: co-ordinating particle, contr. of γε ἄρα, verily then, hence, in truth, indeed, yea, then, why, and when giving a reason or explanation, for, the usage in NT being in general accord with that of cl.;

Causal: [[r:MAT.1.21|Mat 1:21 2:2, 5, 6, 3:23]], [[r:MRK.1.22|Mrk 1:22, 9:6]], [[r:LUK.1.15|Luk 1:15, 18]], [[r:JHN.2.25|Jhn 2:25]], [[r:ACT.2.25|Act 2:25]], [[r:ROM.1.9|Rom 1:9, 11]], [[r:1CO.11.5|1Co 11:5]], [[r:REV.1.3|Rev 1:3]], al.; giving the reason for a command or prohibition, [[r:MAT.2.20|Mat 2:20 3:9]], [[r:ROM.13.11|Rom 13:11]], [[r:COL.3.3|Col 3:3]], [[r:1TH.4.3|1Th 4:3]], al.; where the cause is contained in an interrog. statement, [[r:LUK.22.27|Luk 22:27]], [[r:ROM.3.3|Rom 3:3 4:3]], [[r:1CO.10.29|1Co 10:29]]; καὶ γάρ, for also, [[r:MRK.10.45|Mrk 10:45]], [[r:LUK.6.32|Luk 6:32]], [[r:1CO.5.7|1Co 5:7]], al. id. as in cl. = etenim, where the καί loses its connective force (Bl., §78, 6; Kühner 3, ii, 854f.), [[r:MRK.14.70|Mrk 14:70]], [[r:LUK.1.66|Luk 1:66 22:37]], [[r:2CO.13.4|2Co 13:4]]. The proper place of γάρ is after the first word in a clause, but in poets it often comes third or fourth, and so in late prose: [[r:2CO.1.19|2Co 1:19.]] Yet "not the number but the nature of the word after which it stands is the point to be noticed" (see Thayer, see word). (AS)

G1064.strongs: the stomach; by analogy, the matrix; figuratively, a gourmand
senses: the womb: ἐν γ. ἔχειν, to be with child, [[r:MAT.1.18|Mat 1:18, 23]]" (LXX) 24:19, [[r:MRK.13.17|Mrk 13:17]], [[r:LUK.21.23|Luk 21:23]], [[r:1TH.5.3|1Th 5:3]], [[r:REV.12.2|Rev 12:2]]; εν γ. συλλαμβ., to conceive, [[r:LUK.1.31|Luk 1:31.]] † (AS)

G1065.root: a primary particle of emphasis or qualification (often used with other particles prefixed)
G1065.kjv: and besides, doubtless, at least, yet
senses: γε, enclitic postpositive particle, rarer in κοινή than in cl., giving special prominence to the word to which it is attached, distinguishing it as the least or the most important (Thayer, see word), indeed, at least, even (but not always translatable into English);

More frequently with other particles: αλλά γε, [[r:LUK.24.21|Luk 24:21]], [[r:1CO.9.2|1Co 9:2]]; ἄρα γε, [[r:MAT.7.20|Mat 7:20 17:26]], [[r:ACT.17.27|Act 17:27]]; ἆρά γε, [[r:ACT.8.30|Act 8:30]]; εἴ γε (Rec. εἴγε), [[r:2CO.5.3|2Co 5:3]], [[r:GAL.3.4|Gal 3:4]], [[r:EPH.3.2|Eph 3:2 4:21]], [[r:COL.1.23|Col 1:23]] (see Meyer, Ellic., on Ga, Eph, ll. with; Lft., on Ga, Col, ll. with); εἰ δὲ μήγε, following an affirmation, [[r:MAT.6.1|Mat 6:1]], [[r:LUK.10.6|Luk 10:6 13:9]]; a negation, [[r:MAT.9.17|Mat 9:17]], [[r:LUK.5.36|Luk 5:36, 37 14:32]], [[r:2CO.11.16|2Co 11:16]]; καί γε (Rec. καίγε, cl. καὶ... γε), [[r:LUK.19.42|Luk 19:42]] (WH om.), [[r:ACT.2.18|Act 2:18 17:27]]; καίτοιγε (L καίτοι γε, Tr. καί τοι γε), [[r:JHN.4.2|Jhn 4:2]]; μενοῦνγε (see see word); μήτι γε, see: μήτι; ὄφελόν, [[r:1CO.4.8|1Co 4:8.]] † (AS)

G1066.forms: Γεδεών, ὁ, indecl. in LXX and NT, in FlJ, Ant., see 6, 3 and 4 -ῶνος (Heb. גִּדְעוֹן)

G1067.forms: γέεννα (γέενα, [[r:MRK.9.45|Mrk 9:45]], Rec.), -ης, ἡ (perh. through Aram. גֵּיהִנָּם, from Heb. גֵּי הִנֹּם, [[r:NEH.11.30|Neh 11:30]]; גֵּי בֶּן־הִנֹּם, [[r:JHN.18.16|Jhn 18:16]]; גֵּי בּנֵי־הִנֹּם, [[r:2KI.23.10|4Ki.23:10]]; valley of (the son, sons of) lamentation)
G1067.strongs: valley of (the son of) Hinnom; ge-henna (or Ge-Hinnom), a valley of Jerusalem, used (figuratively) as a name for the place (or state) of everlasting punishment
senses: Gehenna, a valley W. and S. of Jerusalem, which as the site of fire-worship from the time of Ahaz, was desecrated by Josiah and became a dumping-place for the offal of the city. Later, the name was used as a symbol of the place of future punishment, as in NT: [[r:MAT.5.29|Mat 5:29]], [[r:MAT.10.28|; 10:28]], [[r:MRK.9.43|Mrk 9:43, 45 47]], [[r:LUK.12.5|Luk 12:5]], [[r:JAS.3.6|Jas 3:6]]; γ. τ. πυρός, [[r:MAT.5.22|Mat 5:22 18:19]], prob. with ref. to fires of Moloch (DB, ii, 119b); υἱὸς γεέννης, [[r:MAT.23.15|Mat 23:15]]; κρίσις γεέννης, 23:33.† (AS)

G1068.strongs: oil-press; Gethsemane, a garden near Jerusalem
senses: Γεθσημασεί (Rec. -νῆ, LTr. -νεῖ) indecl. (Heb. גֵּת שְׁמָנִי, oil-press), Gethsemane: called in [[r:JHN.18.1|Jhn 18:1]] a κῆπος, but named only in [[r:MAT.26.36|Mat 26:36]], [[r:MRK.14.32|Mrk 14:32]].† (AS)

G1069.strongs: a neighbour (as adjoining one's ground); by implication, a friend

G1070.strongs: to laugh (as a sign of joy or satisfaction)

senses: In late writers, generally (MGr., see Kennedy, Sources, 155), with accusative, before genitive, [[r:MRK.15.36|Mrk 15:36]], [[r:JHN.2.7|Jhn 2:7 6:13]], [[r:REV.15.8|Rev 15:8]]; ἀπό, [[r:LUK.15.16|Luk 15:16]], Rec. WH, mg.; ἐκ, [[r:LUK.15.16|Luk 15:16]], WH, [[r:REV.8.5|Rev 8:5.]] Pass., absol.: [[r:LUK.14.23|Luk 14:23.]] † (AS)

G1073.forms: γέμω (used only in present and impf.)
G1073.strongs: to swell out, i.e. be full
senses: before ἐκ: [[r:MAT.23.25|Mat 23:25]]; (with) with accusative of thing(s) (called a solecism in WM, 251; Bl., §36, 4), as in later Gk. from Byz. to Mod. times (Jannaris, Gr., 1319): [[r:REV.17.3|Rev 17:3.]] † (AS)

G1074.strongs: a generation; by implication, an age (the period or the persons)
senses: race, stock, family (in NT, γέννημα, which see).

of the contemporary members of a family: pl., [[r:MAT.1.17|Mat 1:17]] (cf. [[r:GEN.31.3|Gen 31:3]], מוֹלֶדֶת); metaphorically, of those alike in character, in bad sense, [[r:MAT.17.17|Mat 17:17]], [[r:MRK.9.19|Mrk 9:19]], [[r:LUK.9.41|Luk 9:41 16:8]], [[r:ACT.2.40|Act 2:40]];

of all the people of a given period: [[r:MAT.24.34|Mat 24:34]], [[r:MRK.13.30|Mrk 13:30]], [[r:LUK.21.32|Luk 21:32]], [[r:PHP.2.15|Php 2:15]]; pl., [[r:LUK.1.48|Luk 1:48]]; esp. of the Jewish people, [[r:MAT.11.16|Mat 11:16 12:39, 41 42, 45 16:4 23:36]], [[r:MRK.8.12|Mrk 8:12, 38]] [[r:LUK.7.31|Luk 7:31 11:29, 30-32, 50, 51 17:25]], [[r:ACT.13.36|Act 13:36]], [[r:HEB.3.10|Heb 3:10]]" (LXX); τὴν γ. αὐτοῦ τίς διηγήσεται, [[r:ACT.8.33|Act 8:33]] (LXX); (with) the period covered by the life-time of a generation, used loosely in pl. of successive ages: [[r:ACT.14.16|Act 14:16 15:21]], [[r:EPH.3.5|Eph 3:5]], [[r:COL.1.26|Col 1:26]]; εἰς γενεὰς καὶ γ. (= לִדוֹר וָדוֹר, al.), [[r:LUK.34.17|Luk 34:17]], al), [[r:LUK.1.50|Luk 1:50]]; εἰς πάσας τὰς γ. τοῦ αἰῶνος τῶν αἰώνων, [[r:EPH.3.21|Eph 3:21]] (Ellic, in l.; DCG, i, 639f.). † (AS)

G1075.strongs: to reckon by generations, i.e. trace in genealogy
senses: (γενεά, λέγω), to trace ancestry, reckon genealogy; pass., before ἐκ: [[r:HEB.7.6|Heb 7:6.]]† (AS)
a genealogy: pl., [[r:1TI.1.4|1Ti 1:4]], [[r:TIT.3.9|Tit 3:9]] (see CGT, in l., and ib. Intr., xlix ff.; DB, ii, p. 141). † (AS)

G1077.root: neuter plural of a derivative of [[w:G1078]]
senses: γενέσια, -ων, τά, neut. pl. of adj. -ιος, -ον, relating to birth (γένεσις);
in Attic Gk., a commemoration of the dead.
In late Gk., a birthday feast (= cl. γενέθλια; so in π., see MM, Exp., x; cf. also Ῥutherford, NPhr., 184): [[r:MAT.14.6|Mat 14:6]], [[r:MRK.6.21|Mrk 6:21]]. † (AS)

birth: [[r:MAT.1.18|Mat 1:18]], [[r:LUK.1.14|Luk 1:14]] (Rec. γέννησις); πρόσωπον τῆς γ., face of his birth ("what God made him to be," Hort., in l.), [[r:JAS.1.23|Jas 1:23]]; ὁ τροχὸς τῆς γ., the wheel (course) of birth or creation ("the wheel of man's nature according to its original Divine purpose," Hort), [[r:JAS.3.6|Jas 3:6.]] † (AS)

G1079.forms: γενετή, -ῆς, ἡ = γενεή, Ion. for γενεά
G1079.root: feminine of a presumed derivative of the base of [[w:G1074]]

G1080.strongs: to procreate (properly, of the father, but by extension of the mother); figuratively, to regenerate
G1080.kjv: bear, beget, be born, bring forth, conceive, be delivered of, gender, make, spring
senses: of the father, to beget: with accusative, [[r:MAT.1.1|Mat 1:1-16]], [[r:ACT.7.8|Act 7:8, 29]]; before ἐκ, [[r:MAT.1.3|Mat 1:3, 5, 6]].

Of the mother, to bring forth, bear: [[r:LUK.1.13|Luk 1:13, 57 23:29]], [[r:JHN.16.21|Jhn 16:21]]; εἰς δουλείαν, [[r:GAL.4.24|Gal 4:24.]] Pass. (1) to be begotten: [[r:MAT.1.20|Mat 1:20]]; (2) to be born: [[r:MAT.2.1|Mat 2:1, 4 19:12 26:24]], [[r:MRK.14.21|Mrk 14:21]], [[r:LUK.1.35|Luk 1:35]], [[r:JHN.3.4|Jhn 3:4]], [[r:ACT.7.20|Act 7:20]], [[r:ROM.9.11|Rom 9:11]], [[r:HEB.11.23|Heb 11:23]]; before εἰς, [[r:JHN.16.21|Jhn 16:21 18:37]], [[r:2PE.2.12|2Pe 2:12]]; ἐν, [[r:ACT.2.8|Act 2:8 22:3]], (ἁμαρτίαις), [[r:JHN.9.34|Jhn 9:34]]; ἀπό, [[r:HEB.11.12|Heb 11:12]] (WH, mg., ἐγεν-); ἐκ, [[r:JHN.1.13|Jhn 1:13]] 3:6 8:41; with adj., τυφλὸς γ., [[r:JHN.9.2|Jhn 9:2]];, [[r:ACT.22.28|Act 22:28]]; κατὰ σάρκα: κ. πνεῦμα: [[r:GAL.4.29|Gal 4:29.]] Metaphorical; μάχας, [[r:2TI.2.23|2Ti 2:23]]; ὑμᾶς ἐγέννησα, [[r:1CO.4.15|1Co 4:15]], (ὅν), Phm 10; in quotation, [[r:PSA.2.7|Psa 2:7]] (LXX), [[r:ACT.13.33|Act 13:33]], [[r:HEB.1.5|Heb 1:5 5:5]]; of Christians as begotten of God, born again: [[r:JHN.1.13|Jhn 1:13 3:3, 5-8]], [[r:1JN.2.29|1Jn 2:29 3:9 4:7 5:1, 4, 18]] (cf. ἀνα-γεννάω); (Cremer, 146). (AS)

G1081.strongs: offspring; by analogy, produce (literally or figuratively)

Γαλιλαίας, [[r:MRK.1.16|Mrk 1:16]]; ἡ θ. τ. Τιβεριάδος, [[r:JHN.6.1|Jhn 6:1]]), [[r:LUK.5.1|Luk 5:1]].† (AS)

G1085.strongs: "kin" (abstract or concrete, literal or figurative, individual or collective)

G1087.strongs: the eldership, i.e. (collectively) the Jewish Sanhedrin
senses: (γέρων), a council of elders, senate; in NT, of the Sanhedrin (Cl. Rev., i, 43f.; DB, ext., 99): [[r:ACT.5.21|Act 5:21.]]† (AS)

G1089.strongs: to taste; by implication, to eat; figuratively, to experience (good or ill)
senses: to make to taste. Mid., to taste eat: absol., [[r:ACT.10.10|Act 10:10 20:11]], [[r:COL.2.21|Col 2:21]]; with genitive, [[r:MAT.27.34|Mat 27:34]], [[r:LUK.14.24|Luk 14:24]], [[r:ACT.23.14|Act 23:14]]; with accusative (not cl., but see Westc, Heb., l.with; M, Pr., 66, 245), [[r:JHN.2.9|Jhn 2:9.]] Metaphorical, [[r:HEB.6.4|Heb 6:4]]; ῥῆμα θεοῦ, [[r:HEB.6.5|Heb 6:5]] (on case, see supr., and cf. Milligan, NTD, 68) θανάτου (cf. senses: the earth, world: [[r:LUK.21.35|Luk 21:35]], [[r:ACT.1.8|Act 1:8]], [[r:HEB.11.13|Heb 11:13]], [[r:REV.3.10|Rev 3:10]], al.; opposite to οὐρανός, [[r:MAT.5.18|Mat 5:18 11:25]], [[r:MRK.13.27|Mrk 13:27]], al.
opposite to sea or water: [[r:MRK.4.1|Mrk 4:1]], [[r:LUK.5.3|Luk 5:3]], [[r:JHN.6.21|Jhn 6:21]], al.;

a region, country: [[r:LUK.4.25|Luk 4:25]], [[r:ROM.9.28|Rom 9:28]], [[r:JAS.5.17|Jas 5:17]]; γῆ Ἰσραήλ, [[r:MAT.2.20|Mat 2:20, 21]]; Χαλδαίων, [[r:ACT.7.4|Act 7:4]]; ἡ Ἰουδαία γῆ, [[r:JHN.3.22|Jhn 3:22]]; with genitive of person(s), [[r:ACT.7.3|Act 7:3.]] (AS)

G1096.forms: γίνομαι, Ion. and κοινή for Att. γίγν- (M. Pr., 47; Bl., §6, 8 Mayser, 166 f.)
G1096.root: a prolongation and middle voice form of a primary verb
G1096.strongs: to cause to be ("gen"-erate), i.e. (reflexively) to become (come into being), used with great latitude (literal, figurative, intensive, etc.)
G1096.kjv: arise, be assembled, be(-come, -fall, -have self), be brought (to pass), (be) come (to pass), continue, be divided, draw, be ended, fall, be finished, follow, be found, be fulfilled, + God forbid, grow, happen, have, be kept, be made, be married, be ordained to be, partake, pass, be performed, be published, require, seem, be showed, X soon as it was, sound, be taken, be turned, use, wax, will, would, be wrought
senses: of persons, things occurrences, to come into being, be born, arise, come on: [[r:JHN.1.15|Jhn 1:15 8:58]], [[r:1CO.15.37|1Co 15:37]]; a first appearance in public, [[r:MRK.1.4|Mrk 1:4]], [[r:JHN.1.6|Jhn 1:6]], al.; before ἐκ (of birth), [[r:ROM.1.3|Rom 1:3]], [[r:GAL.4.4|Gal 4:4]]; διά, [[r:JHN.1.3|Jhn 1:3]]; βροντή, [[r:JHN.12.29|Jhn 12:29]]; σεισμός, [[r:REV.6.12|Rev 6:12]]; γογγυσμός, [[r:ACT.6.1|Act 6:1]]; χαρά, [[r:ACT.8.8|Act 8:8]], many other similar exx.; ἡμέρα, [[r:LUK.22.66|Luk 22:66]], al.; ὀψέ, [[r:MRK.11.19|Mrk 11:19]]; πρωΐα, [[r:MAT.27.1|Mat 27:1]]; νύξ, [[r:ACT.27.27|Act 27:27.]]

Of events, to come to pass, take place, happen: [[r:MAT.5.18|Mat 5:18]], [[r:MRK.5.14|Mrk 5:14]], [[r:LUK.1.20|Luk 1:20 2:15]], [[r:ACT.4.21|Act 4:21]], [[r:2TI.2.18|2Ti 2:18]], al.; μὴ γένοιτο, far be it, God forbid: [[r:ROM.3.4|Rom 3:4]] (ICC, in l.), [[r:1CO.6.15|1Co 6:15]] and frequently in Pl.; καὶ ἐγένετο, ἐγένετο δέ ( see Burton, 142 f.; M, Pr., 16f.; Dalman, Words, 32 f.; Robertson, Gr., 1042 f.), with indic, [[r:MAT.7.28|Mat 7:28]], [[r:LUK.1.8|Luk 1:8]], al.; before καί and indic., [[r:LUK.8.1|Luk 8:1]], [[r:ACT.5.7|Act 5:7]], al.; with accusative and inf., [[r:MRK.2.23|Mrk 2:23]], [[r:LUK.3.21|Luk 3:21]], al.; ὡς δὲ ἐγένετο, before τοῦ with inf., [[r:ACT.10.25|Act 10:25]]; with dative of person(s), to befall one: with inf., [[r:ACT.20.16|Act 20:16]]; with accusative and inf., [[r:ACT.22.6|Act 22:6]]; with adv., εὖ, [[r:EPH.6.3|Eph 6:3]]; τ́ ἐγένετο αὐτῷ (Field, Notes, 115), [[r:ACT.7.40|Act 7:40]] (LXX); before εἰς, [[r:ACT.28.6|Act 28:6.]]

to be made, done, performed, observed, enacted, ordained, etc.: [[r:MAT.6.10|Mat 6:10 19:8]], [[r:MRK.2.27|Mrk 2:27 11:23]], [[r:ACT.19.26|Act 19:26]], al.; before διά with genitive, [[r:MRK.6.2|Mrk 6:2]], [[r:ACT.2.43|Act 2:43]]; ὑπό, [[r:LUK.13.17|Luk 13:17]]; ἐκ, [[r:LUK.4.23|Luk 4:23]]; ἐν, [[r:1CO.9.15|1Co 9:15]]; ἀπογραφή, [[r:LUK.2.2|Luk 2:2]]; ἀνάκρισις [[r:ACT.25.26|Act 25:26]]; ἄφεσις, [[r:HEB.9.22|Heb 9:22]]; ὁ νόμος, [[r:GAL.3.17|Gal 3:17]]; τὸ πάσχα, [[r:MAT.26.2|Mat 26:2.]]

to become, be made, come to be: with pred., [[r:MAT.4.3|Mat 4:3]], [[r:LUK.4.3|Luk 4:3]], [[r:JHN.2.9|Jhn 2:9]], [[r:1CO.13.11|1Co 13:11]], al.; before ὡς, ὡσεί, [[r:MAT.10.25|Mat 10:25]], [[r:MRK.9.26|Mrk 9:26]]; εἰς (M, Pr., 71f.), [[r:MRK.12.1|Mrk 12:1]]o, al.; with genitive [[r:REV.11.15|Rev 11:15]]; id., of age, [[r:LUK.2.42|Luk 2:42]]; with dative, γ. ἀνδρί ( see Field, Notes, 156), [[r:ROM.7.3|Rom 7:3]], 4; before ἐν, [[r:ACT.22.17|Act 22:17]], [[r:REV.1.10|Rev 1:10]], al.; ἐπάνω, [[r:LUK.19.19|Luk 19:19]]; μετά, with genitive, Mrk.16:, [[r:ACT.9.19|Act 9:19]]; before εἰς, ἐπί (Field, Notes, 135), κατά (ib., 62), with accusative of place, [[r:ACT.20.16|Act 20:16 21:35 27:7]], al.; before ἐκ, [[r:MRK.9.7|Mrk 9:7]], [[r:LUK.3.22|Luk 3:22]], [[r:2TH.2.7|2Th 2:7]], al. Aoristic pf. γέγονα (M, Pr., 52, 145f.; Field, Notes, 1f.), [[r:MAT.25.6|Mat 25:6]], [[r:LUK.10.36|Luk 10:36]], al. Aor. ἐγενήθη (for ἐγένετο, M, Pr., 139f.; Mayser, 379), [[r:MAT.11.23|Mat 11:23]], al. (Cf. απο-, δια-, επι-, παρα-, συμ-, παρα-, προ-.) (AS)

G1097.forms: γινώσκω (= γιγν-: see previous word. So also vulgar Attic, in Inscr., see Thumb, MGV, 207)
G1097.root: a prolonged form of a primary verb
G1097.strongs: to "know" (absolutely) in a great variety of applications and with many implications (as follow, with others not thus clearly expressed)
G1097.kjv: allow, be aware (of), feel, (have) know(-ledge), perceived, be resolved, can speak, be sure, understand
senses: to be taking in knowledge, come to know, recognize, perceive, understand; in past tenses to know, realize; pass., to become known: with accusative, [[r:MAT.22.18|Mat 22:18]], [[r:MRK.5.43|Mrk 5:43]], [[r:COL.4.8|Col 4:8]], [[r:1TH.3.5|1Th 3:5]], al. Pass., [[r:MAT.10.26|Mat 10:26]], [[r:PHP.4.5|Php 4:5]], al.; before ὅτι, [[r:MAT.21.45|Mat 21:45]], [[r:JHN.4.1|Jhn 4:1]], al.; τί, [[r:MAT.6.3|Mat 6:3]]; ἀπό, [[r:MRK.15.45|Mrk 15:45]]; ὅ, [[r:ROM.7.15|Rom 7:15]]; τ. λεγόμενα, [[r:LUK.18.34|Luk 18:34]]; τ. θέλημα, [[r:LUK.12.47|Luk 12:47]]; τ. καρδίας, [[r:LUK.16.15|Luk 16:15]]; with accusative of person(s), of recognition by God, [[r:1CO.8.3|1Co 8:3]], [[r:GAL.4.9|Gal 4:9]]; by Christ, neg., [[r:MAT.7.23|Mat 7:23]]; frequently of the knowledge of divine things, of God and Christ; τ. θεόν, [[r:ROM.1.21|Rom 1:21]] [[r:GAL.4.9|Gal 4:9]]; τ. πατέρα, [[r:JHN.8.55|Jhn 8:55]]; τ. κύριον, [[r:HEB.8.1|Heb 8:1]] (LXX); νοῦν κυρίου, [[r:ROM.11.34|Rom 11:34]]; Χριστόν, [[r:JHN.17.3|Jhn 17:3]], [[r:1JN.3.6|1Jn 3:6]]; τὰ τοῦ πνεύματος, [[r:1CO.2.14|1Co 2:14]]; τ. πνεύμα, [[r:1JN.4.6|1Jn 4:6]]; τ. ἀλήθειαν, [[r:JHN.8.32|Jhn 8:32]]; of Christ's knowledge of the Father (ἐπιγ.), [[r:MAT.11.27|Mat 11:27]] (Dalman, Words, 282ff.). In Hellenistic writers, of sexual intercourse, to know carnally: [[r:MAT.1.25|Mat 1:25]], [[r:LUK.1.34|Luk 1:34]] (Cremer, 153). SYN.: γ., to know by observation and experience is thus prop. disting. from οἶδα, to know by reflection (a mental process, based on intuition or information); cf. also ἐφίστημι, συνίημι. (Cf. ἀνα-, δια-, ἐπι-, κατα-, προ-γινώσκω.) (AS)
